What is the percentage of students whose height is more than 160 cm?
solution:
**Calculation:**

 
 

 Height (in cm)
 No. of students (cumulative frequency)
 Number of students

 up to 155

 16 - 12 = 4

 33 - 18 = 15

 48 - 33 = 15
 
 

Number of students whose height is more than 160 cm = 15 + 15 = 30

Total number of students = 48

Percentage of students whose height is more than 160 cm = 30/48 × 100 = 62.5 %
